title: ConnectedContractGolden
description: Synthetic-only contract evidence. It deliberately has no Docker or product execution receipt; real Docker E2E is a later task's evidence.

execution_shape.description: Fragment / instance counts; Compare's parallelism gate reads only this.

execution_summary.description: Per-plan-node reading built with the official ExplainAnalyzer recipe.

graph_view.description: The single execution graph: plan nodes and their typed relations.

AuditStatementFilter.description:
Product-owned statement-class filter over AuditLoader rows.

`ExcludeDoctorAndNonQuery` keeps only rows whose FE-reported `isQuery` is exactly 1 (official 3.5.14 `ConnectContext.isQueryStmt`: a `QueryStatement` or EXECUTE of a prepared query; statements that fail to parse keep the initial `true`) and whose `stmt` does not start with this product's fixed statement marker. SET/SHOW/DDL/DML rows, rows with a NULL `isQuery`, and this tool's own statements are hidden but counted.

value.description: Base-10 only: JSON numbers are never used for counters.

ConnectedPlanCheckAction.description: The available arm must carry a session-owned capability reference. The unavailable arm cannot carry one, so invalid state/reference matrices are rejected by the wire contract rather than interpreted in the browser.

ConnectedProfileComparisonRequest.description:
Strict input for the connected-only, server-fetched Profile comparison.

The client supplies only opaque IDs; it never submits reports or raw Profile bytes. The API validates the path/body connection ID and both query IDs before it asks the connector for either Profile.

ConnectedProfileComparisonResponse.description: The comparison is assembled exclusively from two Profiles fetched through the same opaque local connection session. `Comparison` already contains the typed attempts and reports, so this wrapper deliberately does not duplicate them.

ConnectedProfileComparisonSide.description: Provenance for one server-fetched side of a connected Profile comparison.

ConnectedProfileFetchAction.description: A Profile action is never an availability claim about the remote cache: `available` means the bounded fetch may be attempted for this row.

statement_filter.description: Explicit statement-class filter for the discovery list. An omitted field keeps the earlier unfiltered request semantics (`all`).
What the requested statement-class filter actually did on the resolved source. Hidden rows are counted, never silently dropped.

observed_at_local.description: Original bounded wall-clock text returned by Audit/ProfileList.

observed_at_utc.description: RFC 3339 text avoids a JavaScript-unsafe epoch-millisecond integer. `None` is required when a fetch response has only a query ID and no independently observed timestamp; the API must not invent UTC.

ConnectedQuerySqlRequest.description: Narrow, session-owned lookup for SQL that was observed during the current discovery generation. Query lists intentionally omit this field.

ConnectedQuerySqlResponse.description: Bounded SQL text returned only after an explicit lookup in the current short-lived connection session. It is never part of query discovery rows.

recommendation.description: The frozen analysis recommendation is composed, never widened.

ConnectedTimestampState.description: Records what the timestamp can prove. AuditLoader emits a wall-clock DATETIME without an origin offset, so a reader-session conversion is an interpretation rather than evidence of the producer's original instant.

audit_statement_filter.description: `isQuery` (TINYINT) and `stmt` were both probed in this session, so the explicit statement-class filter can be applied without a fallback.

fragment_count.description: Distinct `Fragment N:` sections; `None` when they can not be counted.

instance_count.description: Sum of every fragment's `InstanceNum`; `None` unless all are exact.

oneOf.description: Fragment count and every fragment's `InstanceNum` are exact.
Fragments are known but at least one `InstanceNum` is missing or invalid.

query_total_time.description: `Summary.Total` as reported by the FE; independent of operator time.

metric_id.description: A registered metric id of the finding's subject.

ExplainFactKind.description: The small, version-pinned set of plan facts that an Explain-only card may render.  These are estimates or structural facts, never runtime metrics.

ExplainFactValue.description: The value arm remains type-safe while the outer fact tag always expresses availability.  This prevents a formatter fact kind from being mistaken for an availability state on the public wire.

ExplainNodeFact.description: A fact is an exclusive `available`/`unavailable` wire arm.  The unavailable arm carries only a typed kind and stable reason codes, never raw formatter text.  Available facts keep `fact_kind` explicit for a renderer that does not know the source grammar.

ExplainReceipt.description: Receipts that pin the independently versioned Explain surface.  Each component hash is over its actual fixed semantic content. These are available surface pins, not proof that every recipe was applied. Raw-text modes explicitly mark COSTS recipes as not applied in limitations.

graph_view.description: Explain carries the plan graph only. Runtime remains explicitly unavailable in `runtime_state` and is never joined from a Profile.

plan_node_fact_sets.description: Source-ordered typed plan facts.  The client only renders these values; it never reparses raw Explain text or derives a fallback.

runtime_state.description: Explain is plan-only; a runtime field cannot be populated here.

ExplainSourceLocator.description: A locator for Explain source material.  `row_line` ranges are byte offsets in the original MySQL cell, never in a reconstructed joined string.

ExplainSourceView.description: The only text exposed for an Explain is the registered structural grammar. Attribute and SQL text remain outside the response contract.

ExplainVersionContext.description: The narrow, same-connection version envelope for a COSTS plan.  It is intentionally not a `ProfileContext`: an Explain has no runtime profile.

detected_release.description: A registered release only.  Unknown server text is never reflected.

measurements.description: What the rule measured on its subject, in the rule's own terms (a skew ratio, a fan-out ratio, bytes sent, a time share). Empty when the rule publishes no measurement; the browser never derives one.

measurement_changes.description: Rule measurements of the findings named by `added`, `resolved`, `persisting` and `changed`, paired by `measurement_id`. Display text is copied from each side's `Finding.measurements`; the comparator does not compute a measurement delta. Absent in payloads older than v0.6.

partial_evidence.description: Entries from `resolved` or `added` (`rule_id:subject_ref`) whose finding or unique negative evaluation has partial evidence. The backend labels these explicitly; consumers must not infer this from the report state. Older comparisons omit this field and deserialize as an empty list.

FindingMeasurement.description: One value a rule evaluator computed from the typed inputs it compared. The text is formatted by the backend; bounded inputs give an interval.

input_refs.description: Metric cells (`MetricCell.metric_cell_ref`) the value was computed from.

operator_type.description: Physical operator the value belongs to when narrower than the plan node.

threshold_text.description: The rule's trigger condition on this value (e.g. `> 2×`); absent for context values that are not compared.

FindingMeasurementChange.description: One rule measurement of one finding entry, before and after.

baseline_display_text.description: `None` when that side has no such finding or the finding did not publish this measurement; never 0.

baseline_threshold_text.description: Each side's rule condition on this value. They differ when the two findings were triggered on different severity tiers of one rule.

finding_entry.description: The `FindingDelta` entry (`rule_id:subject_ref`) the measurement belongs to.

instance_num.description: FE `InstanceNum`; `None` when missing, ambiguous or invalid (never 0).

restates_edge_id.description: Set on a `fragment_sink` edge whose relation an explicit `plan_child` edge (exchange -> sending fragment root) already states in the opposite direction. A renderer draws the referenced edge and skips this one.

GraphSqlLocation.description: Request-local bounded source excerpt; never a reconstructed SQL expression.

edges.description: This remains source ordered; canonicalization never sorts these edges by ID.

nodes.description: This remains source ordered when the source relation is ordered.

HotspotTier.description: Official thresholds: share > 30% is most consuming, > 15% second. `Boundary` (product contract): the official reading and the text precision interval of the share disagree about one of those thresholds, so the tier is not decidable; the time-share rules report the same input as `suspected` at that boundary.

match_key.description: Structural identity of the counter inside its subject: physical operator (fragment, pipeline, type, plan node, operator id) plus the raw counter name, which separates base/MIN/MAX statistics. Present only when unique within the report, so Compare can pair it across two Profiles of one plan; absent means it can not be paired unambiguously.

bounds.description: Absolute-delta interval. This never carries percentage bounds.

percentage_bounds.description: Percentage-delta interval. This is independent from `bounds`.

OfficialProfileEligibility.description: Server-issued receipt that may bind a standard execution's completed query to one later fixed `ANALYZE PROFILE` read in the same short-lived session.

OfficialProfileEligibilityMethod.description: The only execution method that can issue an official Profile-read receipt. A standard Profile capture is the only execution method; this receipt binds that one attempt to a later official read.

runtime_delta_state.description: Profile/Explain never has a runtime delta until a candidate Profile exists.

time_share_basis_points.description: Share of `QueryCumulativeOperatorTime` in basis points (1/100 percent).

official_profile_eligibility.description: Present only after a verified standard execution in this same session.

outcome.description: Reusing `AnalysisOutcome` keeps connected and offline analysis on one report contract without returning the connector's raw Profile bytes.

ProfileFetchState.description: A `ProfileFetchResponse` is emitted only after the server-side fetch and analysis have succeeded. All unavailable/forbidden cases use a non-2xx `ErrorEnvelope`, so the success DTO has no nullable failure arms.

QueryListStatementFilterCoverage.description: Outcome of the discovery list's statement-class filter. Counts are exact decimal source rows under the same window and status/digest filters and do not depend on the list limit. "Not applied", "indistinguishable" and a real zero stay distinct states.

oneOf.description: `statement_filter = all`: nothing was hidden, so no hidden count exists.
AuditLoader rows with a proven `isQuery` TINYINT and `stmt` column: the same predicate as the Audit history filter.

hidden_doctor_row_count.description: `isQuery = 1` rows whose `stmt` starts with this tool's marker.

oneOf.description: ProfileList rows: `Statement` keeps this tool's marker, but the source has no statement-class column, so non-query statements (for example a load with a Profile) cannot be distinguished and stay visible.

hidden_doctor_row_count.description: Marked rows among the bounded ProfileList rows read this time.

oneOf.description: The resolved source cannot prove which rows this tool sent, so nothing was hidden. `reason` is a stable limitation code.

limitations.description: What the recommendation did not check (the finding's own limitations describe its measurement instead).

next_step.description: What to do first, in one sentence.

recommendation_id.description: Stable id of the recommendation text, e.g. `rec.scan.reduce_read@v1`.

result_effect.description: Whether a correct change is expected to keep the query result.

title.description: Short action title; the finding category names the problem instead.

oneOf.description: Points at where the cost is (time-share rules).
A concrete check for an observed signal (spill, skew, fan-out…).

evidence_refs.description: Exact metric cells (`MetricCell.metric_cell_ref`) of the finding's own subject that this step reads; empty when none is printed.

delta_ids.description: Delta ids from `version-deltas.json` that apply, in file order.

RunningProfileCandidateListRequest.description: A bounded ProfileList-only observation. `at_limit` reports the remote ProfileList cap before Running filtering; `local_truncated` reports the independent caller cap after filtering. Neither is a coverage claim.

statement_filter.description: Hides this tool's own marked statements from the Running list. An omitted field keeps the earlier unfiltered request semantics (`all`).

at_limit.description: The actual, unfiltered ProfileList result reached the remote request cap.

limit.description: Effective local maximum after bounded request normalization.

local_truncated.description: Running candidates exceeded the independent local limit.

profile_observed_at_utc.description: ProfileList does not supply a source sampling timestamp in this contract.

read_at_utc.description: API receipt time, not a source sampling timestamp.

rejected.description: Running rows excluded because their retained shape, ID, or projection was invalid.

statement_filter.description: What the requested statement filter did on the Running rows read this time: `not_applied` or `doctor_only_applied` with the hidden count.

RunningProfileSnapshotResponse.description: A one-off raw Profile read for a query that was observed Running in the supplied discovery generation. The source parser owns `profile_lifecycle`; it is deliberately independent from the earlier ProfileList observation.

read_at_utc.description: API receipt time, independent from ProfileList's unknown source time.

release_deltas.description: A release other than the pack's own: the pack read with the audited deltas of that release (multi-version source audit). Absent for the pack's own release.

line_refs.description: The line of every text source reference in the report, from the adapter's typed locator. Names a reference whose line text is outside the safe allowlist above, so the browser never parses a reference.

SummaryValue.description:
One backend-computed value. `Unavailable` never carries a number, so a missing metric can not be read as zero.

`Exact` means the value equals the official 3.5.14 `ANALYZE PROFILE` reading of the same Profile text (`RuntimeProfileParser` parses the printed counters too). When a counter was printed with less precision than the runtime value (e.g. `28.802ms` is truncated to the microsecond), `bounds` is the interval in `canonical_unit` that contains the runtime value; `None` means every input was printed losslessly.

current_utc_offset_seconds.description: Observed offset at connection time. Historical rows are never converted with this value because daylight-saving rules may differ at row time.

effective_time_zone.description: Session zone unless it is `SYSTEM`, then the server-reported system zone.

session_time_zone.description: Effective time zone of the exact StarRocks session used by the connector.

system_time_zone.description: FE host time zone reported by StarRocks. This resolves a session value of `SYSTEM` without guessing from the application host.

TlsMode.description: `plaintext` reaches any host the user names (unencrypted, explicit choice); `docker_loopback_plaintext` is the literal-loopback test fixture mode.
